name: Priya Iyer
bio:
Priya's fascination with motorsport began during her undergraduate studies in aerospace engineering at IIT Bombay. She excelled in fluid dynamics and aerodynamics, quickly realizing the potential to apply her knowledge to the high-octane world of Formula 1. After graduating top of her class, she secured an internship with a leading aerodynamics consultancy, working on projects ranging from commercial aircraft design to optimizing wind turbine performance. However, her passion lay with motorsport, and she relentlessly pursued opportunities in the industry. 

Priya's drive and expertise led her to a role at a smaller racing outfit, where she quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating her ability to not only understand complex aerodynamic principles but also to translate them into tangible performance gains on the track. Her hands-on approach and collaborative spirit fostered a strong team environment, allowing her to effectively manage projects and mentor junior engineers. Now, as Head of Aero at Aston Martin, Priya is determined to push the boundaries of aerodynamic innovation and help the team achieve championship success. She believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking new ways to optimize airflow and maximize downforce, always with an eye on the bigger picture and the overall performance of the car.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail during work hours.
physical.description: Priya has a focused and intelligent look, with sharp features and a determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct team meetings standing up, believing it encourages more dynamic discussion.
